propositions: complexity-baseline.json has no CI lock preventing contributor changes, unlike module-size-limit.txt which is locked against main in _build-and-test.yml
the baseline entry count can grow silently because test_complexity_baseline.py validates schema and stale entries but not monotonic non-increase of the entry set
CI must semantically compare complexity-baseline.json against main and reject raised ceilings or added entries, permitting only removed entries or lowered ceilings
the module-size-limit lock currently fails open with a warning when git fetch of main fails, allowing an unverified limit from the branch to be compared
a function added at high complexity can be admitted by adding a matching baseline entry in the same change, bypassing the C901 threshold check
